text:
Everything was eaten except part of the soy sauce. Estimates per item:

- Sushi: 4 pieces at about 30 g each is about 120 g, roughly 180 kcal.
- Salad: about 120 g, roughly 25 kcal.
- Dressing: about 15 g, roughly 60 kcal.
- Toast: 2 slices plus some extra pieces, about 75 g, roughly 210 kcal.
- Apple juice: about 250 g, roughly 115 kcal.
- Water: 250 g, 0 kcal.
- Soy sauce: part of it is left over and some ended up spilled on the plate, so roughly 5 g was eaten, about 3 kcal.

Total energy is about 590 kcal.

For mass, food plus juice comes to about 585 g; adding the water brings it to about 835 g. I report 585 g, counting the juice but leaving out the water.
